title: Going deeper: Name the adult load
categoryContext: Growing independence at home, school and online
stageSummary: Notice adult pressure, observable cues and the sentence that is about to leave the mouth.
pressureLine: I don't have time for this.
possibleWeather: Older children may hear pressure as mistrust, public judgement or loss of agency. Make the reason, choice and responsibility visible.
practice: separate adult urgency from the child's worth
principle: Recognise how adult overload changes tone and pacing.
nextSentence: The task still matters. Tell me what is getting in the way, then we can separate adult urgency from the child's worth.
keyLearning: Recognise how adult overload changes tone and pacing.
curriculum: Australian Curriculum v9.0 - Personal and Social capability: Self-awareness
